English: Council Bench
A simple earthwork ring, ringed with logs and benches, where clan elders debate and resolve disputes.
Villagers Shelter
A cluster of hide tents for villagers, offering safety and a communal hearth for cold nights.
Assembly Hut
A large timber-framed hut, thatched and sturdy, where clansfolk gather for announcements and feasting.
Delegate Tent
A broad canvas tent, richly decorated, housing delegates from each clan for joint councils and seasonal planning.
Elders Room
A sturdy timber chamber, reserved for the council of elders, with carved seats and a ceremonial fire pit.
Gathering House
A large wooden hall, roofed with shingles, serving as a center for feasts, moot courts, and clan proclamations.
Speakers Hall
A grand timbered hall with raised dais and benches for speakers, fostering lively debate and clan unity.
Town Meeting Room
An ornate, high-roofed chamber with long benches, where local leaders and prominent families deliberate on tribal law.
Great Assembly Hall
A vast, imposing hall of carved oak pillars, banners, and fire-hearths, where all clans gather for the Thing or great council.
West Hall of Councils
A legendary hall capped with gilded beams, echoing with the voices of lords and chieftains from across the West Germanic world, symbolizing unity and power.
